note: Re-checked Acta Pharmacol Sinica/PubMed 23645012: gelatin-TG-thrombin sealant gave hemostasis 1.20 vs 6.70 min for thrombin alone in grade III-IV canine liver trauma (n=20). Efficacy solid, but 'strong' rests on a single 2013 preclinical study and no marketed vet product exists.

Honest negative upheld: literature confirms alginate microcapsules dominate islet immunoisolation; TG-gelatin nanoshells are a niche cytoprotective coating, not a leading immunoisolation chemistry.

Peer-reviewed evidence TG is used for post-print setting (dry-sprayed on printed surimi); still research-stage. Reasonable.
